tests.title: Full function over 9.0 V to 16.0 V supply
procedure: Connect the WLC-200 to the HIL bench with a programmable supply, a motor/window load model and CAN monitoring. Normalize the controller. Ambient 23 °C.
Set the supply to 9.0 V (limit), then 9.1 V, 13.5 V, 15.9 V and 16.0 V.
At each voltage run manual open/close, express open/close, anti-pinch reversal and send a WLC_Status check.
Repeat at 8.9 V and 16.1 V for information only (just outside the range).

pass_criteria.measure: Full function (manual, express, anti-pinch, CAN status) at each test voltage
pass_criteria.limit: full function at supply voltages from 9.0 V to 16.0 V

tests.title: Manual-only operation between 6.0 V and 9.0 V
procedure: Normalize the controller at 13.5 V.
Set the supply to 8.9 V, 7.5 V and 6.1 V in turn.
At each voltage briefly press the switch (<300 ms) in close and open directions and observe the window.
At each voltage hold the switch and observe movement; release.
Also test at 9.0 V to confirm the boundary behaviour is consistent with TC-001.

pass_criteria.measure: Express mode between 6.0 V and 9.0 V
Manual mode between 6.0 V and 9.0 V

tests.title: Motor stop on undervoltage
procedure: Start the window moving in manual mode at 13.5 V.
Step the supply from 13.5 V to 5.9 V (just below 6.0 V) and capture supply and motor drive on an oscilloscope; measure time from crossing 6.0 V to motor stop.
Repeat with the supply stepped to 5.0 V and 0 V.
Repeat with a slow ramp down through 6.0 V while moving, and at a supply of 6.1 V (just above) confirm the motor keeps running.

pass_criteria.measure: Time from supply below 6.0 V to motor stopped

tests.title: Sleep mode current consumption
procedure: Connect the controller to a 12 V supply (13.5 V nominal, also 9 V and 16 V) with a calibrated microammeter in series, at 23 °C.
Set ignition off, no switch input, CAN bus idle, and wait until the controller enters sleep mode.
Measure the supply current after it settles for 60 s.

pass_criteria.measure: Sleep-mode supply current

tests.title: Reverse battery withstand
procedure: Record a baseline functional check of the controller.
Apply -14 V to the supply input (reversed polarity) for 60 s at 23 °C with current limit per bench safety rules.
Restore normal polarity at 13.5 V.
Repeat the functional check and compare with the baseline.

pass_criteria.measure: Controller function and parameters after -14 V for 60 s

tests.title: Manual mode movement and stop on release
procedure: At 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, hold the switch in the open direction at mid position; then repeat for closing.
Observe movement while held, then release the switch and measure time from release to motor stop (oscilloscope on switch input and motor drive).
Repeat from several positions and at 9.0 V and 16.0 V.

pass_criteria.measure: Window movement while switch is held
pass_criteria.limit: window moves while the switch is held

pass_criteria.measure: Time from switch release to window stop

tests.title: Window movement after ignition off
procedure: Set ignition off with all front doors closed. Operate the switch at 5 s, 59 s (just inside) and 61 s (just outside) after ignition off, in separate runs.
In a separate run, set ignition off, open a front door at 10 s and operate the switch immediately after.
Repeat opening the door at 59 s, and test with a rear door opened only.
Record whether window movement is allowed in each case.

pass_criteria.measure: Window movement permitted after ignition off
pass_criteria.limit: for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first

tests.title: Express mode trigger by short press
procedure: At 13.5 V, normalized, window mid position.
Press the switch for 100 ms, 250 ms, 299 ms (just inside) in the close direction and release; observe whether the window continues to the end.
Press for 300 ms and 350 ms (at and just outside the limit) and observe.
Repeat for the open direction.

pass_criteria.measure: Express mode start for switch press shorter than 300 ms
pass_criteria.limit: starts express mode in the pressed direction

tests.title: Stop express movement by second press
procedure: Start express close, then press the switch in the close direction during travel; measure time from second press to motor stop.
Repeat pressing in the open direction during express close.
Repeat for express open with a second press in each direction.
Measure with an oscilloscope on switch input and motor drive.

pass_criteria.measure: Time from second press to window stop

tests.title: Full travel time
procedure: Set the supply to 13.5 V and 23 °C, normalized, nominal window load.
Use express to move the window from fully open (480 mm) to fully closed (0 mm); measure travel time with CAN position and a timer.
Repeat 5 times.

pass_criteria.measure: Travel time fully open to fully closed

tests.title: Motor stop at end position
procedure: Run express close to 0 mm and express open to 480 mm at 13.5 V.
Monitor motor current and drive output when the end position is reached.
Repeat in manual mode holding the switch past the end position.

pass_criteria.measure: Motor drive at end position
pass_criteria.limit: motor stopped when the window reaches the end position

tests.title: CAN WLC_CloseAll request
procedure: Normalized controller, window open, 13.5 V.
Send CAN WLC_CloseAll from the simulated body controller and observe motion.
Repeat with a pinch obstacle (force above 80 N) at 100 mm in the path and confirm the response.

pass_criteria.measure: Window response to WLC_CloseAll
pass_criteria.limit: closes the window in express mode

pass_criteria.measure: Anti-pinch during CloseAll

tests.title: Express close only when normalized
procedure: With the controller normalized, short-press close and verify express close.
Cause not-normalized state (supply interruption >500 ms).
Short-press close and send WLC_CloseAll; observe.
Normalize per WLC-022 and repeat.

pass_criteria.measure: Express close when not normalized
pass_criteria.limit: available only when the controller is normalized

tests.title: Pinch detection threshold in pinch zone
procedure: Use the HIL pinch force simulation, normalized, closing at 13.5 V.
Apply an obstacle force at 100 mm of 75 N, 79 N (just below) and 81 N, 85 N (just above) in separate runs.
Repeat at 5 mm and 199 mm (inside zone edges) and at 3 mm and 201 mm (outside zone).

pass_criteria.measure: Pinch detection while closing in the pinch zone
pass_criteria.limit: detects a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N

tests.title: Pinch reaction: stop time and reversal distance
procedure: Trigger a pinch at 100 mm with force above 80 N; capture time from detection to motor stop and the reversal distance.

Trigger a pinch at 300 mm... not in zone; instead trigger at 190 mm and 10 mm, and 160 mm (reversal to fully open limit case) using the position model; also a case where less than 150 mm of travel remains to fully open.
Record reversal distance in each case.

pass_criteria.measure: Time from pinch detection to motor stop
Reversal distance
pass_criteria.limit: at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.title: Anti-pinch in manual and express modes
procedure: Normalized, 13.5 V. Close in manual mode and apply an obstacle force above 80 N at 100 mm; observe.
Repeat in express mode.

pass_criteria.measure: Anti-pinch in manual mode
Anti-pinch in express mode

tests.title: Anti-pinch disabled when not normalized
procedure: Make the controller not normalized (supply interruption >500 ms).
Close in manual mode and apply obstacle force above 80 N at 100 mm.
Verify the normalization bit in WLC_Status is not normalized. Then normalize and repeat to confirm reversal.

pass_criteria.measure: Anti-pinch when not normalized

tests.title: Express close inhibit after pinch reversal
procedure: Trigger a pinch reversal and note time.
Attempt express close at 1.9 s (inside inhibit) and at 2.1 s (just outside) after reversal, in separate runs.
Attempt manual close during the inhibit time.

pass_criteria.measure: Express close after a pinch reversal

tests.title: Three pinches within 30 s
procedure: Trigger three pinch detections within 30 s (e.g. at 0 s, 10 s, 29 s).
Attempt express close at 5 s, 30 s and 59 s after the third pinch, and manual close at the same times; after 61 s attempt express.
Run a control case with the third pinch at 31 s after the first and verify no lockout.

pass_criteria.measure: Closing after three pinch detections within 30 s
pass_criteria.limit: closing only in manual mode for the next 60 s

tests.title: Position resolution
procedure: Inject Hall pulses via the HIL motor model corresponding to known position steps.
Move the window in small increments and read position from WLC_Status; compare with reference.
Determine the smallest distinguishable position step.

pass_criteria.measure: Position resolution from Hall pulses

tests.title: Loss of normalization after supply interruption
procedure: Normalized controller, 13.5 V.
Interrupt supply for 400 ms and 499 ms (just inside), then for 501 ms and 600 ms (just outside) and 2 s; read normalization state in WLC_Status after each.

pass_criteria.measure: Normalization state after supply interruption longer than 500 ms

tests.title: Normalization by holding closed
procedure: Start from a not-normalized state.
Hold the switch in close in manual mode with window against the seal for 0.9 s (just inside) and release; check state.
Repeat holding for 1.0 s and 1.1 s.
Attempt the same in express mode.

pass_criteria.measure: Normalization when held fully closed against the seal in manual mode

tests.title: Thermal model existence
procedure: Review software design documentation and code for the motor thermal model, inputs and outputs.
Check the model estimate is observable on the HIL via calibration or diagnostic variable.

pass_criteria.measure: Estimated motor temperature accuracy

tests.title: Thermal current limit, blocking and release
procedure: Force the estimated motor temperature via HIL thermal stimulus to 129 °C and 131 °C; command movement and measure motor current.
Raise to 139 °C and 141 °C; command open and close.
Lower estimated temperature to 121 °C, then 119 °C; command open.
Record current and opening/closing availability at each point.

pass_criteria.measure: Motor current above 130 °C estimated
Movement above 140 °C estimated
Thermal blocking when estimate falls below 120 °C

tests.title: WLC_Status cycle time and content
procedure: Log WLC_Status on CAN for 10 minutes at 13.5 V while idle, moving, and in a fault state.
Compute the period between consecutive messages and min/max.
Check the signals for position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

pass_criteria.measure: WLC_Status period
Message content
pass_criteria.limit: window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state

tests.title: Hall sensor loss detection B1A01
procedure: Drive the motor and remove the Hall signal; time to detection.
Test with a signal loss of 150 ms and 190 ms (just inside, no DTC) and 210 ms, 300 ms (just outside).
Read DTCs and observe motor. Also remove the Hall signal while the motor is not driven.

pass_criteria.measure: DTC B1A01 on Hall signal missing while motor driven
pass_criteria.limit: stored when missing for more than 200 ms

pass_criteria.measure: Motor on B1A01

tests.title: Overcurrent DTC B1A02, motor stop and fault state
procedure: Apply a motor load current of 24 A for 100 ms (no DTC) and 26 A for 40 ms (no DTC), then 26 A for 60 ms and longer.
Read DTCs, monitor motor drive, and observe WLC_Status fault state after DTC storage.

pass_criteria.measure: DTC B1A02 for motor current
pass_criteria.limit: stored when current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms

pass_criteria.measure: Motor when B1A02 is stored
Fault state in WLC_Status when B1A02 is stored

tests.title: Diagnostic response time
procedure: Send diagnostic requests (e.g. read DTC, read identifier) from a tester at 13.5 V, idle and while moving.
Measure time from request to response across 100 requests.

pass_criteria.measure: Diagnostic response time

tests.title: Operation over ambient temperature range
procedure: Place the controller in the chamber with the load simulation, soak at -40 °C, 23 °C and 85 °C for at least 2 h; also test -39 °C and 84 °C.
At each temperature at 13.5 V run manual and express movement, anti-pinch and CAN status checks.

pass_criteria.measure: Controller operation at ambient temperature

tests.title: Wake-up time from sleep
procedure: Put the controller into sleep at 13.5 V.
Press the switch and measure from press to controller active (CAN WLC_Status or motor drive).
Repeat 20 times, also at 9.0 V and 16.0 V.

pass_criteria.measure: Time from switch press to wake
